piezas.titular: Gemini came and went in educational accounts; today the school switches it on or off
piezas.entradilla: In November 2025, anyone using Gemini with an educational account could not tell which features they would find from one day to the next. A year later, Google has opened up features that were then denied to them, but for students’ accounts each school will decide.
cuerpo: On 15 November 2025, in ChatGPT-IA-edu, someone noticed an oddity: the summary of a YouTube video appeared from a Gmail account, but not from an XTEC one, the Departament d'Educació’s. The reply was that educational accounts are more restrictive and that the rollout is slower: the same had happened with Gemini’s images. Another comment added that features came and went with no clear pattern.

The images arrived five weeks later. On 20 December 2025, Google announced on the [Google Workspace Updates blog](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2025/12/all-ages-image-generation-gemini.html) that Gemini’s image generation was opening up to Workspace for Education (Fundamentals, Standard and Plus) and to users of any age; under-18s can ask for tweaks, but cannot upload their own images.

Since then, the pendulum has swung towards control. On 3 November 2026, according to [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2305432/google-says-that-students-in-schools-that-ban-ai-wont-have-access-to-search/), Google announced that Gemini, Gemini in Classroom and Search will be switched off in primary and secondary students’ accounts until the school turns them on, one by one, with controls arriving in the coming months. [The groups discussed that announcement at the start of the month](pieza:2026-11-03/google-ia-cuentas-escolares). Back then, people were waiting to see what Google would give; now, what each school decides.

fuentes.titulo: Google Workspace Updates: Image generation in the Gemini app now available for Workspace users of all ages (20-12-2025)
Engadget: Google says that students in schools that ban AI won't have access to Search (3-11-2026)

piezas.ilustracion_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: two rows, “Gmail” with a video and a tick, and “XTEC” with a video and a red cross. On the right, “Today”: two school buildings, one with a switch turned on and the other with one turned off, next to the label “School”.
piezas.comprobado: Mensajes #42140-#42143 de ChatGPT-IA-edu (15-11-2025) en la entrada; el #42140 existe en t.me/ChatGPTedu (15-11-2025, resumen de vídeo de YouTube con @gmail sí y con @xtec no; no nombra a Gemini, pero las respuestas hablan de Gemini). Blog oficial Google Workspace Updates (20-12-2025), abierto: Workspace for Education Fundamentals, Standard y Plus, todas las edades; los menores de 18 pueden refinar con nuevas peticiones, pero no editar directamente ni usar imágenes subidas. Engadget (3-11-2026), abierto: Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini en Classroom y Search, desactivados para el alumnado K-12 hasta que los administradores los activen, cada uno por separado; controles “en los próximos meses”. No se afirma nada sobre si hoy Gemini resume vídeos de YouTube en cuentas educativas. pieza:2026-11-03/google-ia-cuentas-escolares está en publicado.txt y trata del mismo anuncio. Tema y producto no están entre lo ya contado en “Hace un año”. Medida: 247 palabras con la entradilla.
repaso: En el cuerpo 1: no se afirma que “Gemini resumía” el vídeo (el mensaje no nombra a Gemini): se dice “el resumen de un vídeo de YouTube”; “las novedades les llegan tarde” pasa a “la implementación va más lenta”, como en el mensaje; “Otros contaban” pasa a “Otro comentario añadía”, porque lo dijo una sola persona (otra solo confirmó).
En el cuerpo 2: “un mes después” pasa a “cinco semanas después”; “todas las ediciones de Workspace for Education” pasa a Fundamentals, Standard y Plus, como dice la fuente.
